description.en: Broad horseshoe shield, small dorsal eyes and a gently curved tapering body. Original static child-friendly teaching art; not a scientific reconstruction.
description.zh: 宽马蹄形头盾、顶部小眼及轻弯渐细的躯尾。原创静态儿童场景教学美术，并非严格科考复原。

sources.title: Prehistoric fish: 11 of the largest, weirdest and most significant
sources.notes: Haikouichthys, Cephalaspis, Cheiracanthus, Materpiscis, Dunkleosteus and Leedsichthys identities and selected forms; highlights incomplete whole-body knowledge. Original inventory verification: search-result. This does not assert a new full source reading.

artistic_choices.en: Color, exact proportions, nominal dimensions, pose, simplified plate counts, flanges and fine anatomy are artistic. No third-party image/mesh/texture incorporated.
artistic_choices.zh: 颜色、精确比例、标称尺寸、姿态、简化板列、翼缘和细部为艺术处理；不收录第三方图像、网格或纹理。

scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed stylized-inspired static teaching art. Color, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified fine anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的静态风格化启发教学美术；颜色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化细部属于艺术选择，并非严格科学复原。
